load_checkpoint_from_file: load a PyTorch model checkpoint from a local file path using load_checkpoint
load_pretrained_weights_from_url: load pretrained model weights from a URL using load_pretrained with automatic channel handling
load_checkpoint_with_module_prefix_strip: load a checkpoint and automatically strip module. prefixes from state dict keys
load_pretrained_with_filter_function: load pretrained weights from a URL and apply a custom filter function to the state dict
load_pretrained_with_channel_mismatch_ha: load pretrained weights that automatically handle input channel and classifier mismatches
